title: Block UN-renderer
description: Instantly hide chosen blocks & block entities client-side, with a Sodium-compatible fullbright to see underneath.
body:
# Block UN-renderer

A lightweight, **Sodium-compatible** Fabric client mod for **Minecraft 26.1.2** that instantly hides chosen blocks and block entities — with a built-in fullbright so you can clearly see what's underneath.

## Features
- **Hide any block or block entity** — chests, furnaces, stone, leaves, anything (by ID)
- **Searchable in-game picker** — open the GUI, search by name, click to add/remove (with block icons)
- **Hold or Toggle** trigger modes
- **Show Blocks Underneath** — keep the surface beneath hidden blocks rendered (no holes)
- **Fullbright** (on by default) — every exposed/covered block is fully lit, via a per-block luminance technique that works in vanilla **and** Sodium
- **Instant**, with **zero performance cost when off**

## Controls
- **X** — toggle/hold hiding
- **O** — open the Block Manager GUI
- Rebindable in Options -> Controls; settings also via ModMenu.

## Requirements
Minecraft 26.1.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.2+, Fabric API, ModMenu.

## Notes
Under Iris shaders, the shaderpack controls lighting (use its brightness). Client-side only; for singleplayer and servers you own.

Source: https://github.com/dev-limucc/block-unrenderer
